info.name: ClinicalHarmony · Phase 9b — Silver over Kafka
info.description: Happy-path walkthrough (6 requests) of Phase 9b: clinicalharmony.bronze.ingested → silver-transformer-service → silver.* (+ rules-engine / ontology validation) → Bronze PROCESSED → outbox → clinicalharmony.silver.patient.changed. MLLP isn't HTTP, so messages are sent by the generator from a terminal (see request 3); Postman checks the results through the api-gateway and Kafbat UI. Prereqs: `docker-compose up -d`, migration 24 applied. Failure paths (unmappable message → FAILED, rules-engine down → PENDING_VALIDATION + sweeper, redelivery, DLT) are covered by scripts/smoke-test.sh section 19 and the integration test.

item.name: 1. Auth — sign in as dana (data steward)

request.description: DEV-ONLY password grant on client clinicalharmony-dashboard-dev (same as the Phase 7 collection) so the gateway's Bronze read model can be called. Tokens live 10 minutes — re-run 1 on a 401.
Health only: the service has no business REST API. It reads clinicalharmony.bronze.ingested (consumer group silver-transformer) and writes silver.*.

item.name: 3. Bronze — generated messages PROCESSED into Silver

request.description: Run the generator first, in a terminal from the repo root:  python3 data-generator/generate.py --seed 917  (100 seeded ADT / ORU / RDE messages over MLLP to :8887). bronze-listener stores each one as PENDING; silver-transformer then maps it into silver.* and marks it PROCESSED (or FAILED with the reason). Saves the newest row's id.

item.name: 4. Bronze → Silver — the rows one message produced

request.description: Data Lineage → Bronze message: the raw HL7 plus the silver.* rows linked to it by raw_message_id (observations for an ORU, the medication for an RDE, conditions / allergies for an ADT that brought new ones).

item.name: 5. Validation Report — medication vs allergy conflicts found in Silver

request.description: After each message the transformer validates the patient's WHOLE Silver record through rules-engine-service (which calls ontology-service). The generator deliberately orders some patients the very drug they're allergic to (AL1 vs RXE, both RxNorm), so this rule fires on real Silver ids.

item.name: 6. Kafka — silver-transformer consumer group (Kafbat UI API)

request.description: Lag 0 = every bronze.ingested event has been transformed. Open http://localhost:8090 to browse clinicalharmony.silver.patient.changed (one event per transformed message, CREATED / UPDATED).
